examples.name: Sample — mobility-survey-2024_p13
paragraphs: Four legend series over eight labeled regions, every value printed on its bar: 32 values, rows labeled from the axis and columns from the legend, verbatim. Region abbreviations stay as printed (SEA, ME, NEA). The values printed in heavier type are bold in the table; the red ones carry no colour mark, since colour on a data label is styling.
